units: pixels (original 2160x1080 image coordinates, x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.motion: static (phase correlation of a static region vs frame 0: |shift| < 0.01 px for all sampled frames)
camera.duplicate_first_frame: frames 0 and 1 are identical (mean abs diff 0.03 grey levels); every object is at the same place in frames 0 and 1, motion visible from frame 1->2
camera.view: elevated view looking down onto a four-way intersection (city street, sidewalks, traffic lights)

perspective.vp_vertical_note: from the two traffic-light poles (356,442)-(473,794) and (1614,527)-(1701,192); rough (two lines only)
perspective.focal_note: f^2 = -(VP1-c).(VPvert-c) with principal point c=(1080,540) -> f ~ 1100 px (HFOV ~ 89 deg). Cross-check: the implied second ground VP (~(119,-47)) lies on the diagonal road's curbs (355,51)-(1016,318) and (1546,544)-(2159,792), which extend to (112,-47) and (85,-47). Treat as ~10% uncertain; prefer calibrating from given depths.
perspective.horizon_note: nearly horizontal, just above the top of the image (y ~ -47); camera pitched down ~28 deg

van.desc: large white cargo van (Chevy Express type), the biggest object; starts in the right foreground and drives away toward the upper-left road
van.notes: bbox clipped by the bottom/right image edges in frames 0-14; never occluded

taxi.desc: yellow/orange taxi sedan with a roof sign; starts behind (above) the van, drives away then turns right toward the right-hand road, ends near the right traffic light
taxi.notes: partly hidden by the van and by the cyclist in frames 0-14; occlusion flag also set 26-43 (van rear near its lower edge); pole/ped-signal of the right traffic light in front of its rear end in the last frames

cyclist.desc: man in a dark suit and jeans on a bicycle, starts in front of the taxi's front-left, rides toward the upper-left ahead of/left of the van, disappears behind the van (frames ~40-70, head/shoulders visible above its roof) and reappears at its rear right corner at frame 71
cyclist.notes: reference point = top of the head; full rider+bike extent reliable only frames 16-35

pedestrian.desc: man in a white T-shirt and blue jeans walking on the right sidewalk, near the green trash bin, away from the camera (toward the upper right)

purple_sedan.desc: dark purple/navy classic sedan parked on the far side of the intersection, facing left

green_convertible.desc: teal/green convertible in the left foreground, cut off by the left image edge

traffic_light_left_foreground.desc: big double traffic-light head on a pole in the left foreground, pedestrian signal (green walker) lower on the same pole

traffic_light_left_far.desc: traffic light with green lamp and a triangular pedestrian-crossing sign on top, on the upper-left sidewalk

traffic_light_center_far.desc: traffic light with sign at the far corner (top centre)

traffic_light_right.desc: traffic light with triangular sign and red pedestrian signal on the right sidewalk corner

trash_bin.desc: green trash bin on the right sidewalk next to the pedestrian's start

brick_planter_right.desc: red-brick tree grate / planter on the right sidewalk

brick_planter_left.desc: red-brick planter at the left image edge (cut off)

brick_planter_far.desc: red-brick planter at the far corner under the centre traffic light

street_lamps.desc: ornate black street lamps along the far and right sidewalks

bench_or_sculpture.desc: dark object (bench/sculpture) on the far right sidewalk

sidewalk_corners.desc: curb corner points of the four sidewalks

roads.desc: grey asphalt, no lane markings or crosswalk stripes visible; an east-west road (runs from the left edge to the upper right) crosses a diagonal road (upper-left to lower-right)

events.what: first frame; frame 1 is an exact duplicate
all four movers show motion from frame 1 to 2 (van starts from near rest: steps 2,3.5,4 px/frame, increasing)
cyclist passes in front of the taxi's front-left (image overlap, no visible contact) and moves left of the van's front
van image step peaks (~19-20 px/frame) then decreases as it recedes
taxi image x stops decreasing and starts increasing: the taxi turns right toward the right-hand road (heading change)
cyclist progressively hidden behind the van (only head/shoulders visible ~48-70)
last frame; cyclist reappears beside the van's rear right corner; nobody has stopped

apparent_size_vs_time: see notes.md table; van bbox width 794 px (f0, clipped) -> 533 (f30) -> 208 (f71); taxi bbox height 231 (f0) -> 112 (f71); pedestrian height ~103-116 px roughly constant; cyclist head-to-wheel height ~114 px (f18) -> ~98 (f36)
